cd work && python3 -c "
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import glob, os
files = sorted(glob.glob('overview/t*.jpg'))
cols, rows = 6, 7
per = cols*rows
cw, ch = 320, 180
lab = 16
n = len(files)
import math
npages = math.ceil(n/per)
for p in range(npages):
    chunk = files[p*per:(p+1)*per]
    W = cols*cw
    H = rows*(ch+lab)
    canvas = Image.new('RGB',(W,H),(0,0,0))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    for i,f in enumerate(chunk):
        idx = int(os.path.basename(f)[1:5])
        t = (idx-1)*30
        hh=t//3600; mm=(t%3600)//60; ss=t%60
        im = Image.open(f)
        r = i//cols; c=i%cols
        x=c*cw; y=r*(ch+lab)
        canvas.paste(im,(x,y+lab))
        d.text((x+2,y+2),f'{hh:02d}:{mm:02d}:{ss:02d}',fill=(255,255,0))
    canvas.save(f'mont_{p:02d}.jpg',quality=70)
    print('mont_%02d.jpg'%p, chunk[0], chunk[-1])
"
